assumptions: Per-crew daily usage for food (~1.8 kg incl. packaging), drinking water (~2.5 L) and oxygen (~0.84 kg) are rounded from NASA's Life Support Baseline Values and Assumptions Document (BVAD). Verify against the current BVAD before quoting exact numbers.
Energy use (20 kWh/day for the whole habitat) is a round prototype assumption, not a real mission value.
Water is modeled as net consumption after recycling, so we do not simulate the recycling loop itself.
Starting amounts are chosen so food is the bottleneck at the start of the demo (24 days vs. a 28-day resupply window).
This is a HACCP-inspired supply-risk screening prototype. It is not a certified food-safety system.
